window_opened_6_lines.line: the Text Editor window opened (with 28 things in it)
window_opened_6_lines.why: the change we caused; part-whole subsumption folded 28 appearances into it
the top-bar window label, outside the new window's area, so containment cannot fold it in
the same top-bar slot lost its Terminal label; replacement pairing does not fire because the slot's new occupant is a moved item, not the appeared one
the window list reflowed when the new window took focus
the top bar recentred when a title was added. Not the clock ticking: a tick is now folded into its own value change and judged volatile

residual.what_false_changes_counts: everything beyond the one line naming the intervention, which over-counts: a window opening legitimately moves other things, and the scorer cannot tell that from noise. The breakdown above is the number to read.
residual.what_would_fix_the_doubled_reports: a list-reflow interpretation: an insertion into a list shifts its other rows, so that is one change and not N. Not built - it would be a fifth structural interpretation and the gain on this trial is 6 lines -> 3.
